_meta.purpose: Code-verified identifiers, limits, and change-together sets that no context doc enumerates. Every value cites the file that owns it. The code wins if they disagree; update this file in that case.
_meta.not_here_on_purpose: Stack, ADRs, corpus row counts, eval scores, milestones, and feature status live in context/architecture.md, docs/adr/, docs/eval/, context/HANDOFF.md, and feature-specs/v2-implementation-plan.md. Structure (modules, routes, flows) lives in docs/codemap.html.

core_token.format: <M|m>:<roman core>, e.g. M:I, M:V/V, m:iv. M = major-mode key, m = minor-mode key. `.core` omits inversions and 9/11/13 extensions; those live only in `.figure`.
core_token.rules: Recommendation input must be all chords or all core tokens. Core tokens require a key whose mode matches every token's prefix.

graph_node_id.format: <kind>:<label>, e.g. function:M:I. Graph routes accept the shorthand M:I / m:iv and prefix `function:` for you.

context_key.context_id: hcg.contexts.id (smallint) is stable across corpus versions; 0 = global.
context_key.values: Lowercased. The recommend service maps '' and 'unknown' to no context.
context_key.predictor_backoff_chain: genre_section → genre → section → global. Decade is never used for prediction.

fact_id.corpus: transition:<from_core>-><to_core>:global. Persisted per version in hcg.facts; verified with FactStore.existing_ids (≤20 per call).

corpus_version.format: cv-YYYY-MM-<a-z0-9{1,12}> (the job payload regex). The active version comes from `select hcg.v()`; exactly one active row is enforced by a partial unique index.
local_only_artifacts: eval-train-a (train split only; never loaded to Supabase)

ngram_orders.convention: Order 1 = unigram (empty history). Order n has n-1 history tokens joined by a single space.

color_axis.note: Must match in two places: backend/app/color/features.py AXES and backend/pipeline/load.py COLOR_AXES (a pre-existing F10-era constant, not itself derived from AXES).

postgres_loader_statement_timeout.value: 20min (set local, inside the single load transaction)

cache.kn_discount_cache_entries: 64, per KNPredictor instance. The API builds a new instance per request, so only _COUNT_CACHE persists across requests.

request_bounds.recommend: 1–128 chords, each ≤80 chars; limit 1–20 (default 10); genre/section ≤80 chars; the predictor ranks top 100 before the mode filter and realization
request_bounds.graph_path: k 1–5, max_len 1–6, ≤50,000 search expansions; cost = -ln(p) (+0.5 for non-TRANSITIONS_TO edges)
request_bounds.examples: limit 1–5; exactly one of pattern_id or transition ("<from>-><to>")
request_bounds.recommend_evidence: ≤20 transition pairs per read, ≤2 examples each

jobs.auth: X-HCG-Jobs-Token header compared in constant time. Without HCG_JOBS_ADMIN_TOKEN every /v2/jobs route returns 503.

storage_gates.min_context_edge_count: 5 (contextual TRANSITIONS_TO below this are not loaded; global edges are always kept)
storage_gates.enforced: Inside the load transaction. Over the gate means rollback, and the previous active version stays.

pipeline_thresholds.examples: top 50 global transitions, 5 examples per key
pipeline_thresholds.memory_guard_cap: min(8192 MB, 50% of RAM), whole process tree; os._exit(1) on breach

backend.DATABASE_URL: API + worker. Must be postgresql+psycopg:// for Postgres. The default is a local sqlite file under backend/.tmp.
backend.DATABASE_URL_LOAD: Optional direct (non-pooler) URL used by the graph_rebuild job/loader.
backend.REDIS_URL: Enables cache L2, rate limits, and queue. Required by the worker.
backend.HCG_CORPUS_VERSION: Only echoed by GET /health (default 'unversioned'). Not the active DB version.
backend.HCG_ENABLE_DEMO_FALLBACK: v1 next-chords/transition-stats fall back to in-code demo transitions.

frontend.HCG_API_ORIGIN: Read at build time by next.config.ts rewrites (default http://127.0.0.1:8000).
frontend.CRON_SECRET: Required by /api/cron/keepalive; set by Vercel Cron.

change_together.what: Genre/section options offered in the UI
files: contexts actually retained in the active corpus (hcg.contexts)
change_together.note: The UI lists classical/electronic/country/r&b without checking that the corpus kept them. Unretained ones silently back off to broader contexts, with a warning.

files: backend/pipeline/load.py load_corpus() (set local search_path = hcg, extensions, public)
backend/app/db/session.py (the app's own SQLAlchemy connect_args, same value)
change_together.note: Any future loader code using an unqualified pgvector/extensions operator (not a fully-qualified type) needs this; production roles already have it, a fresh CI/local Postgres role does not. Found via a real backend-pg CI failure (F51), not assumed.
